0022600191.text: The Knicks (4-4, 7th in the East) visit the Cavaliers (5-4, 6th in the East) in the 9th game of New York's season, with the Knicks on a two-game winning streak and 3 games back in the Atlantic. Josh Hart is out for New York with an ankle injury, while Cleveland is missing Jarrett Allen (knee), Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), and Sam Merrill (elbow), and the Cavaliers, 1.5 games back in the Central, have won their last game. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, but the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1 and the 2025-26 playoffs 4-0, including a 130-93 win in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
